name: SIM Ownership Desk
idea: Helps telecom shop staff verify identity for SIM registration and re-registration, explaining each document requirement to customers.
twist: Flags walk-ins registering many numbers or numbers linked to scam reports for a second check.
sources: Pine AI (VNPT AI Hackathon 2025 (The Dreamer track), Vietnam, 1st) — AI agent for customer service centres that handles natural voice conversations and automates support and sales workflows with personalised upsell suggestions.

name: No-Signal Complaint Engineer
idea: Maps customer 'no signal' complaints to nearby cell-site alarms and planned maintenance so contact-centre agents can give real causes.
twist: Clusters complaints with no matching alarm to reveal silent site failures for the network operations centre.
sources: Empathos (VNPT AI Hackathon 2025 (The Dreamer track), Vietnam, 2nd) — Conversational assistant for telecom operators that replaces IVR menus so customers resolve issues on first contact.

name: Branch KYC Copilot
idea: Walks bank branch staff through customer due diligence when opening accounts, prompting for enhanced checks on mule red flags.
twist: Notices signs of a coached customer, such as a companion answering, and drafts an internal suspicious-activity note.
sources: BIPBIP (Branch Intelligence Platform) (BPI D.A.T.A. Wave Hackathon 2025, Philippines, Digitalization Track Champion) — AI analytics platform that optimises bank branch customer flow, staff productivity and service delivery.

Mule Observation Detection Engine (KrungsriUniVerse x KMITL Hackathon: Mule Hunt Challenge 2025, Thailand, 1st) — Detects mule bank accounts by analysing links between gambling and loan networks tied to account trading plus social data, to block risk networks at the source.

name: ทวงถามถูกกฎ · lawful collections
idea: Drafts collection scripts and letters for bank collection officers and checks contact timing and frequency against debt-collection rules.
twist: Identifies borrowers likely eligible for restructuring and offers that path before escalating collection.
sources: Claimsio (MAS Global FinTech Hackcelerator 2025, winner, Singapore FinTech Festival) — AI-native debt collection service for SMEs that replaces collection agencies with automated soft-collection workflows and factoring.

name: Farmer Group Credit Memo
idea: Writes a credit memo for a farmer group loan from crop calendar, expected yield, market price and household cash flow.
twist: Builds a repayment schedule aligned to harvest months instead of fixed monthly instalments.
sources: Kaleidofin (G20 TechSprint 2024 (BIS & Banco Central do Brasil), winner, Brazil) — Provides data-driven credit assessment tools with predictive risk models to finance businesses through innovative debt structures at lower cost.

name: Mis-selling Mystery Shopper
idea: An adversary agent poses as an elderly depositor to test bank branch sales scripts for insurance sold as if it were a deposit.
twist: A judge agent scores each conversation against suitability rules and shows compliance which script lines caused failures.
sources: Oxford Risk (MAS Global FinTech Hackcelerator 2025, winner, Singapore FinTech Festival) — Trains bank AI models on behavioural insights into investor decision-making to deliver hyper-personalised financial advice.

Probe (C:\>DIR Global Agentic Regulator Hackathon 2026, 6th place, Cambridge UK) — Uses an adversary agent posing as customers and a judge agent to run thousands of test conversations against AI financial advice systems.

name: ภาษีที่ดิน Use Classifier
idea: Classifies each land parcel's actual use from survey photos and documents for a local authority's land and building tax roll.
twist: Flags vacant urban land dressed up as agriculture, such as sparse token planting, for re-inspection.
sources: TARA (Anthropic Built with Opus 4.6 Claude Code Hackathon 2026 (virtual), Keep Thinking Prize) — Converts dashcam footage into road infrastructure investment appraisals with economic analysis and equity assessments in hours instead of weeks.

name: แผนพัฒนาท้องถิ่น Builder
idea: Turns villagers' requests from community forums into a sub-district development plan with projects mapped to provincial strategy.
twist: Checks each project against expected budget and flags requests that belong to another agency's mandate.
sources: Polisense.AI (AI x City Climate Action Hackathon 2025 (Global Covenant of Mayors), winner, Climate Week NYC) — AI energy-access co-pilot that helps local governments target energy investments where they will have the most community impact.

name: Child Protection Case Conference
idea: Organises a child-welfare case file into a risk assessment and service plan for the multidisciplinary team meeting.
twist: Highlights conflicting statements between school, hospital and family reports for the social worker to resolve.
sources: Baan Oon Jai (AFTERKLASS Business KAMP 2025: Youth for Good (KBank), Thailand, 1st) — AI that supports child-welfare officers in assessing and matching children with suitable adoptive or foster families.

name: Fake Broker Ad Hunter
idea: Finds investment ads impersonating licensed Thai brokers or funds and builds timestamped evidence packs for the regulator.
twist: A human-supervised honeybot replies to the ad to capture the bank accounts and LINE IDs used.
sources: Project Zeus (C:\>DIR Global Agentic Regulator Hackathon 2026, Honorary Award, Cambridge UK) — Human-governed multi-agent honeybot system that detects investment fraud ads and gathers enforcement evidence.

name: Money Trail Mapper
idea: Normalises bank statements from many banks into one schema and traces scam money through layers of mule accounts for an investigating officer.
twist: Produces a court-ready fund-flow chart where every arrow links back to the source statement line.
sources: Mule Observation Detection Engine (KrungsriUniVerse x KMITL Hackathon: Mule Hunt Challenge 2025, Thailand, 1st) — Detects mule bank accounts by analysing links between gambling and loan networks tied to account trading plus social data, to block risk networks at the source.

Tax Aggregation Model (Oxford Legal Tech Hackathon 2026 (BRYTER & Reed Smith), 1st place, Oxford) — Collects tax data from two companies in an M&A deal, normalises it into a unified tax schema and stores it for tax risk management.

name: Thai Trademark Similarity Examiner
idea: Compares a new trademark application against registered marks visually and by Thai pronunciation, as a trademark examiner would.
twist: Handles Thai-script look-alikes and sound-alikes that differ only by tone marks or vowel spelling.
sources: Warhol (Stanford CodeX LLM x Law Hackathon 2026 (FutureLaw Week), Harvey Challenge Award, Stanford) — Uses vision models to find visually similar images online and applies copyright law and case law to assess infringement risk.

name: Burn Scar Verifier
idea: Matches satellite hotspots and burn scars with field reports to separate crop burning, forest fires and false alarms for a provincial office.
twist: Prioritises patrol routes for forest-fire volunteers by smoke drift toward towns.
sources: AgroSentinel (4th FAO-CAAS Youth Hackathon on One Health 2025, 3rd prize (New Service Track)) — Satellite-guided early warning system combining remote sensing and AI to monitor antimicrobial resistance and zoonotic disease risk on farms.

EcoGuardian.AI (AI x City Climate Action Hackathon 2025 (Global Covenant of Mayors), winner, Climate Week NYC) — Uses AI, GIS and remote sensing to detect land degradation in real time and produce risk maps and alerts for cities.

name: EIA Measures Tracker
idea: Checks a project's periodic environmental monitoring report against each mitigation measure promised in its approved EIA.
twist: Lists measures with no reported data or results trending out of range, for the environmental reviewer.
sources: Tese (G20 TechSprint 2024 (BIS & Banco Central do Brasil), winner, Brazil) — Builds ESG dashboards that streamline sustainability reporting for small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: PIPO Vessel Inspector
idea: Helps Port-In Port-Out inspectors cross-check a fishing vessel's logbook catch against its VMS track and landing declaration.
twist: Scores which arriving vessels to inspect first based on track anomalies and catch inconsistencies.
sources: PLACI (KaiTETHON 2026 (Kale Logistics Solutions), overall winner, Mumbai) — AI pre-loading cargo risk analyst that analyses advance cargo information to flag risks before loading.

Sixth Sense for Security Guards (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), 4th place) — Video monitoring system that uses Gemma 3n to distinguish genuine threats from benign events in real-time security footage.
